description.smtp: Configure the SMTP mail server separately for verification codes and transaction notifications. A blank secret preserves the current value.
description.ses: Configure Tencent Cloud SES separately. SES and SMTP never fall back to each other automatically.
description.sms: Configure Tencent Cloud SMS separately for mainland China phone verification and transaction notifications. SMS is disabled by default.
field.ses.template_transaction: Simplified Chinese transaction notification template ID (optional)
field.notification.fallback_locale: Fallback language when a provider template is missing
field.sms.template_transaction: Simplified Chinese transaction notification template ID (optional)
email.enable: Save and enable this email channel
action.test: Send a test email to my administrator address
hint.smtp: SMTP supports only 465 TLS or 587 STARTTLS. Test email is sent only to the current administrator address.
hint.ses: SES requires a valid region, sender address and three verification templates. A blank secret preserves the current value.
hint.sms: SMS uses approved Tencent Cloud signatures and templates. Mainland China phone registration and binding remain closed when SMS is disabled or incomplete.
message.error.permission_denied: This administrator cannot manage delivery settings.
message.error.smtp_configuration_invalid: Complete the SMTP settings and use encrypted port 465 or 587.
message.error.ses_template_invalid: SES template IDs must be positive integers.
message.error.transaction_template_inval: Transaction template IDs must be positive integers, and the configured fallback language must have a template for each enabled channel.
message.error.sms_configuration_invalid: Complete the SMS settings before enabling phone verification.
message.error.verification_rate_limited: Too many test sends. Try again later.
message.error.delivery_test_failed: Test delivery failed. Check the service settings and provider status.
message.error.email_delivery_unavailable: Save and enable a valid email configuration first.
message.error.csrf_invalid: Your session expired. Sign in again.
message.error.generic: The operation could not be completed. Check the input or sign in again.
message.test_sent: The provider accepted the test email. Check your administrator inbox.
hint.notification_templates: Transaction email and SMS templates are selected from the user's saved language. If that language has no provider template, the configured fallback language is used. English SMS templates must use the same four parameter positions as the Simplified Chinese template.
coverage.title: Notification language coverage
coverage.description: The configured fallback language is {language}. Rows show what each registered locale would actually receive; unavailable means the channel or a usable transaction template is not configured.
